_readme: The M7 gate's declared corpus (#129 AC-1/AC-2). Written down BEFORE the run, because a
criterion whose content is improvised at the mic cannot be scored — and because AC-2's
denominator is 'facts stated', which has to be a fixed 20 to be a denominator at all.
'say' is what the operator says aloud, in a natural conversation, NOT read as a list.
'match' is every lowercase substring that must appear in a stored row for it to count as
this fact — deliberately loose on phrasing (the model stores the user's own words, §7.6)
and strict on content. 'probe' is the question asked after the restart; recall is judged
on whether THIS fact comes back, not on how the answer sounds.
ORDER MATTERS: recall (AC-2) is scored before supersede (AC-4) and forget (AC-5) run, or
the two of them silently lower the AC-2 score by mutating the store it grades.

facts.say: My name is Ali
I live in Beirut
I work as a software engineer
facts.probe: what do I do for work?

facts.say: My birthday is the ninth of November
I drink black coffee, no sugar
facts.probe: what do I drink in the morning?

facts.say: I can't stand loud music
facts.probe: how do I feel about loud music?

facts.say: I love spicy food
facts.probe: what kind of food do I like?

facts.say: I always pick the window seat
facts.probe: which seat do I prefer on a plane?

facts.say: I run on Tuesday mornings
I read for half an hour before bed
facts.probe: what do I do before bed?

facts.say: I do the grocery shop on Saturday
My team standup is at nine every weekday
My sister Maya is a doctor in Cyprus
facts.probe: what did I say about my sister?

facts.say: My manager is called Sam
The neighbour's dog is called Biscuit
facts.probe: what is the neighbour's dog called?

facts.say: My oldest friend Karim lives in Berlin now
I'm flying to Cyprus in September
facts.probe: where am I travelling in September?

facts.say: I started guitar lessons in June
We moved into this flat two years ago
I'm running the marathon next spring

semantic_probes._why: AC-3: the pre-injection block cannot cover this — it has to trigger the recall tool.
semantic_probes.query: what did I say about my sister?

semantic_probes._why: AC-3's proper-noun case — the branch §7.7 built FTS5 for, where a vector alone fails.
A second proper noun, on a person rather than a pet.
semantic_probes.query: what do I know about Karim?

supersession._why: AC-4: the new fact wins the present, the old one stays queryable as history (§7.8).
supersession.say: I've switched to tea, I don't drink coffee any more
supersession.probe_present: what do I drink in the morning?
supersession.probe_history: what did I used to drink?

forget._why: AC-5: a rights operation, verified at the database — row, FTS shadow, embedding, all gone.
forget.say: Forget what I told you about the neighbour's dog
